Bulgarian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *naborъ (equivalent to *na- +‎ *borъ (“assembly”)). Meaning “cohort” is borrowed from Russian набо́р (nabór), from the same proto-Slavic word.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈnabor]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -abor
  • Syllabification(key): на‧бор

Noun

[edit]

на́бор • (nábor) m (relational adjective на́борен)

  1. collection, set, kit of things
    набор от средства ― nabor ot sredstva ― set of instruments/means
  2. (printing) type, forme (collection of letters composed on a chase in order to be printed on paper)
    набор за печат ― nabor za pečat ― typesetting [ready] for printing
  3. cohort (group of people sharing some characteristic)
    → (military) enrollment, recruitment class
    → (colloquial) coeval, age-mate (a person of the same age)

Etymology 2

[edit]

O-grade deverbal of набера́ (naberá, “to pick up”), formally identical to Etymology 1.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Western dialects) IPA(key): [ˈnabor]
    • Rhymes: -abor
  • (Eastern dialects) IPA(key): [nɐˈbɔr]
    • Rhymes: -ɔr
  • Syllabification(key): на‧бор
This entry needs an audio pronunciation. If you are a native speaker with a microphone, please record this word. The recorded pronunciation will appear here when it's ready.

Noun

[edit]

на́бор or набо́р • (nábor or nabór) m (dialectal)

  1. fold, corrugation, pleat (of a cloth, garment)
    набор на пола ― nabor na pola ― fold of a skirt

Russian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *naborъ.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [nɐˈbor]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

набо́р • (nabór) m inan (genitive набо́ра, nominative plural набо́ры, genitive plural набо́ров)

  1. set, kit, outfit, collection (collection of various objects for a particular purpose, such as a set of tools)
  2. (printing) font type case containing movable type
  3. (printing) typesetting, composition
  4. (printing) typesetting plate
  5. enlistment, admission, levy, recruitment, enrollment
  6. wire gage, gauge
  7. bank of cells
  8. dialing (telephony)
  9. (aviation) climb
